verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Marlin is driven by a natural-language research topic: you give it a topic, it refines direction through a brief exchange with the user, then runs autonomously to produce a report and slides. Natural-language input is the primary way to operate the product. Missing for 10: documentation of the natural-language interface itself (prompt format, what commands it accepts), natural-language steering or revision during or after a run (only cancel is mentioned), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
